title: Why potential BJP-SAD alliance could be game changer for both; and a worry for AAP, Congress
content: Haryana chief minister Nayab Singh Saini has categorically denied any prospective alliance with Shiromani Akali Dal for 2027 Punjab assembly elections. However, recent discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal have led to renewed speculation around possible tie-up. After the meeting, SAD, whose electoral fortunes have waned significantly, changed its perspective on delimitation. The BJP is reportedly keen on dominating any potential alliance.

title: Pune conversion case: UK-based OCI holder booked under new Maharashtra law
content: Pune Police registered an FIR against a UK OCI cardholder for alleged religious conversion attempts.  The accused allegedly spoke about Jesus and made statements about Hindu deities.  In a separate case, a 21-year-old man was arrested under the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Act.  This development follows a wider debate over religious conversion and foreign funding.  Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis stated that transparent organizations have nothing to fear.

title: Born in Ronaldo's hometown, ex-Australia cricketer to lead Portugal's T20 WC bid
content: Henriques, who played four Tests, 16 ODIs and 24 T20Is for Australia, will lead Portugal's 14-member squad at the T20 World Cup Europe Sub-Regional Qualifier C in Finland.

title: IPL cricketer Abishek Porel arrested on rape charge; woman alleges promise of marriage
content: Bengal Police arrested cricketer Abishek Porel on Tuesday in connection with a rape case.  The arrest followed a directive from the Calcutta High Court regarding the complaint.  A medical student alleged a physical relationship on the promise of marriage.  The complaint also includes charges of criminal intimidation and recording intimate moments.  Porel's career is now overshadowed by these ongoing legal proceedings.

title: America's new rule will make some companies pay more for H-1B, L-1 visas
content: Effective September 9, new regulations from the U.S. government will introduce increased visa fees for certain categories of workers, specifically targeting H-1B and L-1 visa holders applying for extensions. Companies with over fifty employees utilizing a significant number of visa workers will also experience the higher financial burden as these changes pertain to initial petitions and status extensions.

title: Speeding BMW runs over woman in Delhi, villagers block road near T-3 terminal
content: A 48-year-old house help was killed by a speeding BMW car in Delhi. The driver, identified as Deepak, was apprehended by police officials after the incident. Angry locals blocked a road in protest, disrupting traffic movement near the airport. The victim's family expressed their desire for justice and strict action against the driver. Authorities have registered a case and initiated legal proceedings against the apprehended driver.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a stranded boat incident. The vessel's crew was reportedly on a different radio channel during the emergency. Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.

title: 'Discontent answered with bullets': MEA slams Pakistan over PoK crackdown
content: India's external affairs ministry has strongly denounced Pakistan's actions concerning Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, where protests were met with brutality, leading to numerous fatalities. The Joint Awami Action Committee, prohibited from operating, led rallies demanding a fair distribution of refugee seats. Additionally, upcoming elections in the region were marred by violence and claims of electoral fraud, prompting India to call on the global community to hold Pakistan accountable for these violations.

title: Malaysia’s Princess Ilyana marries British GT racer Chris Froggatt
content: Tengku Puteri Raja Tengku Puteri Ilyana Alia, daughter of Pahang Sultan Al-Sultan Abdullah, married British racing driver Christopher Lionel Froggatt in Kuala Lumpur on August 7. The ceremony was attended by members of the Pahang royal family and followed traditional Islamic wedding customs, including the presentation of ‘mas kahwin’, ring exchange and ‘merenjis’.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
content: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: PM Modi, Shah, Sonia, Rahul attend reception of Supriya Sule’s daughter - pics
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah attended Revati Sule's wedding reception.  Rahul Gandhi and Sonia Gandhi were also present at the high-profile event.  Sharad Pawar hosted the reception for his daughter Supriya Sule's daughter.  Several Union ministers and opposition leaders joined the celebration.  The event brought together leaders from across the political spectrum.

title: Harbhajan Singh bowls ‘doosra’ after Punjab Police fact-checks video on drug crisis
content: BJP MP Harbhajan Singh responded after Punjab Police fact-checked a viral video he shared. He stated the drug issue cannot be dismissed by questioning video locations. Singh shared another video, questioning its origin and stressing Punjab's drug crisis. He criticized paid trolls for attempting to hide the significant drug problem. Singh urged the Punjab government to focus on making the state drug-free.

title: 'Arunachal an integral part, nothing can change that': MEA on China's 'objections'
content: The external affairs ministry firmly asserts the integral status of Arunachal Pradesh as part of India. This statement is a response to China's persistent efforts to impose Chinese names on various places in the state. A total of twenty-seven historically and strategically important locations have been officially identified on the Survey of India map. New Delhi categorically dismisses China's renaming initiatives as invalid.

title: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' trailer out: Gaddi war gets bigger
content: The gripping Mirzapur saga is set to transition from web series to cinema! A recently released trailer showcases fan-favorite characters and electrifying combat, as the struggle for the Gaddi intensifies across uncharted territories and introduces new faces. Featuring an all-star cast, Mirzapur: The Movie is destined to captivate audiences when it releases on September 4, 2026.

title: Russell Wilson’s father Harrison Wilson III and his lasting NFL influence
content: The impact of Harrison Wilson III, Russell Wilson’s father, on his life is profound. With a background as an Ivy League graduate and a wide receiver for the San Diego Chargers, Harrison instilled values of perseverance and ambition in his children. Post his impressive 14-season NFL career, Russell channels his dad’s influence into philanthropic work via the Why Not You Foundation, championing the pursuit of dreams.

title: How Travis Kelce’s kindness helped Laila Edwards make Olympic history
content: Travis Kelce's philanthropic spirit shines through as he starts by donating one hundred dollars to Laila Edwards' hockey tournament fund, later upping the ante with a generous ten thousand dollars for her Olympic travel. This heartfelt contribution allowed her family to celebrate her gold medal triumph, highlighting the Kelce brothers' true character and commitment to supporting young athletes on their monumental journeys.

title: ‘Game on’: Prakash Raj’s challenge after his name ‘deleted’ from Bengaluru voter list
content: Actor Prakash Raj's name was unexpectedly removed from the electoral roll in Bengaluru, prompting him to question the integrity of the revision process. Deeply rooted in the area, he is committed to taking steps to restore his voting rights. He firmly believes that denying the electorate their power won't hinder change, as citizens can express their will through the democratic process.

title: LeBron James and Savannah James suffer a major community loss ahead of 76ers season
content: LeBron James and his wife, Savannah James, were preparing for their new chapter with the Philadelphia 76ers but they have been faced with a brutal loss in their community.

title: Air India CEO meets MoCA, DGCA amid Phuket flight turbulence probe
content: Air India's departing CEO recently conferred with government representatives about a serious turbulence event that led to injuries and hospitalizations of those on board. The investigation is focused on potential mechanical failures and pilot behavior. Interestingly, the pilot's initial test for psychoactive substances did not return negative. Further steps will depend on the outcomes of the ongoing investigations and confirmation tests.

title: Relief for Adani group: US court permanently dismisses criminal case; bizman reacts
content: Responding to the ruling, Gautam Adani said, "Truth has prevailed," adding that he respected the judicial process and expressed gratitude to those who had supported the Adani Group during the proceedings. He also reaffirmed the conglomerate's commitment to "nation-building" and "long-term value creation."

title: RBI guv asks banks to build human oversight, says blaming technology is 'unacceptable'
content: Reserve Bank governor Sanjay Malhotra stressed human accountability for AI decisions. Banks must ensure technology supports human judgment, not replaces it entirely. Meaningful human oversight is crucial from the AI design stage. Cyber security and model bias present significant risks for lenders. Banks must maintain an inventory of AI models and governance policies.

title: ‘Wanted both children’s custody’: Why Bengaluru man killed 2 daughters at 5-star hotel
content: A father allegedly killed his two minor daughters at a Bengaluru hotel. He then attempted suicide after a dispute over child custody. The girls were found dead in their hotel room on Monday. Police recovered a note from the room detailing marital discord. The father confessed to strangling his children before his arrest.

title: India’s Russian oil imports hit record; refined fuel flows to nations sanctioning Moscow
content: The US sanctions waiver on Russian crude has expired and a fresh tariff threat of up to 100% looms as the Trump administration pushes for a Russia sanctions bill that gives the American president powers to impose tariffs on biggest oil importers from Moscow.

title: Mauritius visit highlights India's defence outreach to Africa as major powers vie for influence
content: Admiral Krishna Swaminathan visits Mauritius to enhance maritime security cooperation. India's naval chief's visit signals deepening strategic partnership with Mauritius. An Indian Army contingent participated in Côte d'Ivoire's Independence Day parade. This event highlights India's growing defense diplomacy across the African continent. India continues to expand its defense footprint and strategic alliances abroad.

title: ‘For now, I am the captain’: Afridi breaks silence on Babar captaincy reports
content: Shaheen Shah Afridi stated he is currently the captain of Pakistan's ODI team.  He is focusing on the National Champions Cup to build team depth.  This tournament will help identify potential replacements for the World Cup.  Speculation continues regarding Babar Azam potentially leading across all formats.  The Pakistan Cricket Board has not officially confirmed any leadership changes.

title: Rs 10, Rs 20 polymer notes get field-trial nod: What will change from paper currency?
content: India is preparing to roll out polymer banknotes for initial trials shortly. The Reserve Bank of India plans to launch one billion pieces each of Rs 10 and Rs 20 denominations. These innovative polymer notes will coexist with current paper currency, with the goal of improving the longevity of lower denomination notes. Additionally, parliament discussions included topics on inflation and taxation strategies.

title: Yeida to launch 2 residential plot schemes near Noida airport during Navratri
content: Exciting news for home seekers! The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority is gearing up to unveil two new residential plot schemes aimed at low-income groups and the general public. Strategically located near the Noida International Airport, these initiatives come on the heels of a previous successful allotment of 973 plots, though prior applicants will not qualify this time around.

title: As Gulf tensions reach Bab el-Mandeb, Indian Navy escorts cargo ships through troubled waters
content: Indian naval ships are escorting cargo vessels through the Bab El Mandeb strait.  The INS Trishul and INS Aditya are currently providing this vital maritime security.  These operations ensure the safe transit of energy cargo and protect national interests.  The navy has maintained anti-piracy patrols in the Gulf of Aden since 2008.  Operation Sankalp, launched in 2019, has become a cornerstone of India's maritime security.

title: Indian Army’s tech leap: 6G, quantum, AI cloud and 300 capability projects in the works
content: The Indian Army is significantly modernizing its forces through advanced technology adoption.  It is integrating technologies like 6G and quantum computing into its operations.  Indigenous procurement of defense equipment is rapidly increasing, with a strong focus on domestic vendors.  The army is also developing in-house drone systems for autonomous weapon capabilities.  These initiatives aim to enhance digital infrastructure and weapon systems for future conflicts.

title: Watch: India’s Russian oil imports hit 48% as U.S. readies 100% tariffs
content: Russia’s share of India’s crude oil imports hit an all-time high of 48% in June 2026, even as the United States moves closer to imposing tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas. India imported 8.7 million metric tonnes of Russian crude in June, while overall crude imports fell sharply. The UAE also recorded a historic 17.5% share, meaning Russia and the UAE together accounted for nearly two-thirds of India’s oil imports.
